admission.justification: Guarded by mcp/tests/test_launch_identity_confirmation.py and prevents a seat from spoofing another role's sender attribution in coordination messages.

applicability: Every role_message delivery whose sender line is formatted by sender_line in paseo_role_caller.py.
conditions: sender_line derives the sender identity exclusively from the calling tool server's bound AgentBinding environment.
Spoofed identity text in message content or caller arguments cannot alter the formatted sender line.
exclusions: Does not prevent a process whose own OS environment carries another seat's binding variables from presenting that server's bound identity; launch confirmation (BUG-R51@v1 §2) and self-check (BUG-R51@v1 §3) prevent cross-seat binding.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_launch_identity_confirmation.py (Rule 5 sender-identity tests passed on tree 9d6c1659c736677568d180e75fd23228782d1f36); L51-W1-expanded-evidence.md#bug-r51-v1

statement: A role_message call derives its sender line exclusively from the calling tool server's bound agent environment and cannot be spoofed by message text or caller arguments.
title: role_message sender line comes strictly from bound server environment
